mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of triggered periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60d returns in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20d returns in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in INDPRO and a fall in HOUST over the same month indicates supply chain inflation without corresponding housing demand growth, which erodes corporate margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > previous month AND HOUST < previous month in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20d returns in more than 50% of months where INDPRO rises and HOUST falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in PAYEMS of more than 1% signals significant job losses, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenues, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 5d returns in more than 40% of months with PAYEMS falling by over 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL over two months signals a successful disinflationary tightening, which boosts market confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous month AND CPIAUCSL < previous month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves negative 60d returns in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls for two months in a row.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals rising household savings and reduced consumption, which depresses earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average for four months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent divergence between INDPRO and GDPC1 growth (INDPRO growth > GDPC1 growth for three consecutive months) signals inefficient supply utilization, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > GDPC1 growth for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20d returns in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO outpaces GDPC1 for three months.
